title: Request a Kubernetes namespace
summary: Get your own namespace on the shared Kubernetes clusters, with resource limits, access for your team and deployment through Argo CD. Use it for every new service that runs in containers.

resources.title: Skill: add a namespace
resources.description: Lets an AI coding assistant write the namespace file and open the pull request for you.

resources.title: k8s-tenants
resources.description: One file per namespace: limits, access groups and the Argo CD project.

prerequisites.title: A GCP project for your application
prerequisites.description: Images are pulled from the artifact registry of your project, and cloud resources stay there.

prerequisites.title: Service registered in the service catalogue
prerequisites.description: The namespace is labelled with the service id, owner and tier from the catalogue.

prerequisites.title: Access group for your team
prerequisites.description: The group gets edit access to the namespace, e.g. k8s-payments-editors.

actors.name: You
actors.description: The engineer who will deploy the service.

actors.name: Argo CD
actors.description: Applies the tenant files to the clusters.

steps.title: Work out the size of your namespace
steps.description: The limits stop one service from taking the capacity of others. Ask for what you expect in the next six months; it can be raised later.
instructions: Count the services you will run in the namespace.
Estimate CPU and memory per service from a load test or a similar service.
Add 30% headroom and round up to whole CPUs and GiB.
steps.outcome: CPU and memory limit for the namespace

steps.title: Add your namespace file to k8s-tenants
instructions: Fill in the service id, owner team, tier, CPU and memory limit and your access group.
Open a pull request and add the label 'new-namespace'.

resources.title: Skill: add a namespace
resources.description: Writes the namespace file from your service id and opens the pull request.

steps.title: Check limits, labels and access group
Make the changes the platform team asked for
instructions: Read the review comments on the pull request.
Change the namespace file and push to the same branch.
Reply to each comment and ask for a new review.

steps.title: Create the namespace on every cluster
steps.description: On merge, Argo CD creates the namespace, the limits, the network policy and the access bindings on the development, test, staging and production clusters.

steps.title: Check you can deploy to the namespace
instructions: Open Argo CD and find the project named after your service id.
Check that the namespace shows as Healthy on every cluster.
Deploy the hello-world example from the handbook to the development cluster and delete it again.
steps.outcome: A working namespace on every cluster
